items.statement: Bottoms-up sizing put driftless's reachable market near ninety million dollars a year.
items.verbatim_anchor: call it ninety million a year reachable, bottoms up

items.statement: The driftless sizing assumed two hundred thousand target companies with twenty-plus knowledge workers.
items.verbatim_anchor: two hundred thousand companies with twenty plus knowledge workers

items.statement: The user said the driftless deck leads with the bottoms-up number, not a top-down TAM.
items.verbatim_anchor: the deck leads with the bottoms up number, no top down fluff

items.statement: Adjacent idea: schedule freight pickup windows against emissions curves, using Lumopact-style data.
items.verbatim_anchor: schedule freight pickups against the emissions curve, Lumopact adjacent

items.statement: The user chose to keep the emissions-scheduling tangent out of the driftless deck.
items.verbatim_anchor: the emissions tangent stays out of this deck

items.statement: At forty dollars per calendar, a thousand companies of fifty calendars is 2.4 million in ARR.
items.verbatim_anchor: a thousand companies at fifty calendars is two point four million

items.statement: Seeing the market math laid out made driftless feel real to the user rather than a toy.
items.verbatim_anchor: seeing the math laid out makes this feel real instead of a toy

items.statement: A calculator widget on the driftless site could let buyers size their own savings.
items.verbatim_anchor: let buyers run their own savings math in a little calculator widget

items.statement: A stale currency cell skewed the first sizing pass before being fixed.
items.verbatim_anchor: a stale currency cell skewed the first pass, fixed now

items.statement: The user said they will re-run the driftless sizing quarterly once pilot data lands.
items.verbatim_anchor: re-run the sizing every quarter once pilot data lands
